notes.title: Optimization Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Heroes!
This update focuses on optimizing the game for better performance.
We've especially improved performance issues that caused significant lag in countries using specific languages.
Thank you for your support!

Also, our Patreon page is now live — we’d love your support and interest!
Enter the Game | Patreon

notes.title: Update #02
notes.notes:
Game Balance Adjustments
- The overall difficulty has been slightly increased, excluding the very early stages.
- The amount of gold earned and the amount required for upgrades have been adjusted.
- Some masteries have been adjusted.
- Skill appearance rates have been partially adjusted.


Class-specific Mastery Added
- A mastery that applies only to specific classes has been added.


Other Quality of Life Improvements
- Sound adjustment function added.
- Resolution memory storage has been enhanced.
- Potion descriptions added.


German Language Added
